providers.practical_next: Existing integration minimizes engineering changes; review reasoning/total-token budget before a separate bounded public-owned-fixture canary.

If Groq access unavailable, verify existing project free tier/no active paid billing and model quota; separate adapter/transport review required. Unpaid input/output data use precludes private customer source.

current_groq_adapter_observation.budget_risk: Very small output allowance can truncate reasoning/finalJSON; hidden reasoning is not disabled reasoning. Do not classify unexecuted/tokens-exhausted canary as model coding failure.

recommended_reviewed_canary_configuratio.pace: At most1request/minute; failclosed on429/insufficientquota, no automaticretry. Check actual account TPM before approval.
recommended_reviewed_canary_configuratio.response_format: json_schema strict true; exact trusted line enums; unchanged independent validators
recommended_reviewed_canary_configuratio.inputs: Existing SHA-pinned public owned fixtures only; no customer code/PII, payment metadata or secrets
recommended_reviewed_canary_configuratio.needed_code_review: Separate total reasoning+visible budget from retained finalJSON/source-change constraints; test cap, diagnostics, truncation, usage and secrets. Current150cap must not be silently bypassed.
recommended_reviewed_canary_configuratio.evidence: Record attempt count, model ID/backend fingerprint if supplied, finish reason, prompt/totalcompletion/reasoning usage if supplied (unknown if absent), wall time, schema/stage rejection and Docker test result; no raw reasoning/credential logging.
